Description: Main CTA button with brand color background
Do: Use brand primary color; min 44x44px touch target; include hover/pressed states
Don't: Use without text label or smaller than 44px tap area

Description: Outlined/ghost button for secondary actions
Do: Use outlined style with brand color border; maintain same size as primary
Don't: Make visually heavier than primary button

Description: Button with only an icon, no text label
Do: Always include aria-label; use consistent icon size (24px); min 44x44px hit area
Don't: Use without aria-label or with inconsistent icon sizes

Description: Link-style button for low-emphasis actions
Do: Use text color with underline on hover; maintain consistent padding
Don't: Make it look like a regular link without button semantics

Description: On/off switch for binary state controls
Do: Use clear visual distinction between on/off states; include aria-pressed
Don't: Use same color for both states without clear differentiation

Description: Circular button for primary action, typically bottom-right
Do: Use brand color; include elevation/shadow; min 56x56px size
Don't: Place without considering safe areas or thumb reach zone

Description: Selectable pill-shaped element for filtering or selection
Do: Use clear selected state with filled background; maintain consistent height
Don't: Mix filled and outlined chips at same hierarchy level

Description: Group of mutually exclusive options in a pill shape
Do: Highlight selected segment clearly; maintain equal sizing for all segments
Don't: Make segments different sizes or use inconsistent spacing

Description: Single selection from multiple options
Do: Use visible radio indicator; group with aria-roledescription
Don't: Hide the radio button and only show text labels

Description: Multiple selection from options
Do: Use visible check indicator; group with aria-roledescription
Don't: Hide the checkbox and only show text labels

Description: Single-line text entry field
Do: Include visible label above or beside input; show validation state clearly
Don't: Use placeholder-only labels without persistent labels

Description: Multi-line text entry field
Do: Set appropriate rows attribute; include label and character count if needed
Don't: Use fixed height without considering content overflow

Description: Single selection from a list of options
Do: Show current value clearly; include search if >8 options
Don't: Hide the selected value or use placeholder as default

Description: Calendar-based date selection input
Do: Show current month/year clearly; highlight selected date; include clear labels
Don't: Use ambiguous date format without clear labels

Description: Continuous value selection via drag
Do: Show current value; include min/max labels; use visible track and thumb
Don't: Hide the current value or make thumb too small to grab

Description: Button or drop zone for file selection
Do: Show file preview when available; indicate supported formats and size limits
Don't: Use generic "Upload" without format/size guidance

Description: Text field with search icon and clear button
Do: Include search icon; show clear button when text entered; include autocomplete if applicable
Don't: Hide the input type or use generic text input without search semantics

Description: Password field with visibility toggle
Do: Include strength indicator; show/hide password button; include requirements list
Don't: Hide password requirements until after first failed attempt

Description: Horizontal navigation bar at top of page
Do: Include logo, primary nav items, and CTA; use sticky positioning for long pages
Don't: Hide the navbar on scroll without showing a way to get it back

Description: Vertical navigation panel for app navigation
Do: Use icons + labels; highlight active section; collapse on small screens
Don't: Use only icons without labels or hide the sidebar permanently

Description: Mobile navigation with tabs at bottom of screen
Do: Max 5 items; use icons + labels; highlight active tab clearly
Don't: Use more than 5 tabs or hide labels on mobile

Description: Hierarchical navigation showing current page location
Do: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth; include home as first item
Don't: Use on flat single-level sites or omit the home link

Description: Full-width dropdown with categorized navigation links
Do: Group links into logical categories; include search if many items; keyboard accessible
Don't: Overwhelm users with too many options without categorization

Description: Page navigation for long lists or search results
Do: Show current page clearly; include first/last page links for long lists
Don't: Use only previous/next without showing total pages or current position

Description: Collapsed navigation for mobile screens
Do: Include clear open/close animation; maintain keyboard accessibility when expanded
Don't: Hide the menu without a clear way to close it or lose scroll position

Description: Header that follows user during scroll
Do: Maintain consistent height; reduce content on scroll if needed; don't obscure main content
Don't: Change header size dramatically on scroll causing layout shift

Description: Tabular data display with sorting and filtering
Do: Include sortable column headers; show row count; use zebra striping for readability
Don't: Use without alternating row colors or missing sort indicators

Description: Container for grouped content with image, title, description
Do: Use consistent card sizing; include clear visual hierarchy within card
Don't: Mix card sizes randomly or use inconsistent padding between cards

Description: Placeholder shown when no data exists
Do: Include illustration, descriptive text, and CTA to create content
Don't: Show only "No results" without guidance on what to do next
Code Good: No items yet

Description: Placeholder showing content shape during loading
Do: Match skeleton dimensions to actual content; use shimmer animation
Don't: Use generic gray boxes that don't match final layout

Description: Small visual indicator for status or category
Do: Use semantic colors; include text alternative for screen readers
Don't: Rely on color alone to convey meaning without text/icon fallback

Description: Hover/focus popup with additional information
Do: Show on hover and focus; include dismiss mechanism for touch devices
Don't: Hide tooltip on mobile where there is no hover state

Description: Collapsible content sections
Do: Use clear expand/collapse indicators; maintain keyboard accessibility
Don't: Hide the expanded state or use inconsistent expand icons

Description: Visual indicator of task completion progress
Do: Include percentage text; use aria-valuenow for screen readers; show indeterminate state
Don't: Hide the progress value or use only color without text alternative

Description: Full-width banner for important messages
Do: Use semantic role; include dismiss button; maintain contrast with background
Don't: Hide the alert without a way to dismiss or use low-contrast colors

Description: Temporary popup notification that auto-dismisses
Do: Include duration indicator; allow manual dismiss; announce to screen readers
Don't: Auto-dismiss without warning or hide from screen readers

Description: Overlay dialog for focused interactions
Do: Trap focus within modal; include close button; use backdrop overlay with scrim
Don't: Allow clicking outside to dismiss without explicit confirmation

Description: Side panel that slides in from edge of screen
Do: Include close button; maintain keyboard focus trap; use backdrop overlay
Don't: Hide the drawer without a clear way to reopen it

Description: Modal for confirming destructive actions
Do: Show action name clearly; include cancel option; highlight destructive button in red
Don't: Use same styling for confirm and cancel buttons

Description: Error message shown next to form field
Do: Show error icon; use red color with text alternative; include specific guidance
Don't: Use only red color without text or show generic "Invalid" message

Description: Visual confirmation of successful action
Do: Use green checkmark; include brief success message; auto-dismiss after delay
Don't: Show only a color change without text confirmation

Description: Animated indicator for ongoing operations
Do: Use accessible name; respect prefers-reduced-motion; show context message
Don't: Animate without text alternative or ignore reduced motion preference

Description: Responsive column-based layout structure
Do: Use consistent gutters; define breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop
Don't: Mix grid and non-grid layouts without clear visual separation

Description: Centered content wrapper with max-width
Do: Use appropriate max-width for readability (65-75ch for text)
Don't: Let text span full viewport width without constraints

Description: Visual separator between content sections
Do: Use appropriate thickness and color; maintain consistent spacing around divider
Don't: Use inconsistent line weights or colors for different dividers

Description: Custom illustration for empty data states
Do: Include descriptive text below illustration; provide CTA to create content
Don't: Show only illustration without context or action guidance

Description: Bottom section with links and copyright info
Do: Include essential links; use semantic HTML; maintain consistent spacing from content
Don't: Hide the footer or make it non-scrollable on long pages

Description: Full-width top section with headline and CTA
Do: Include accessible heading; use appropriate contrast for text overlay on background image
Don't: Use low-contrast text over busy backgrounds without sufficient padding

Description: Input with suggestion dropdown
Do: Use aria-autocomplete; highlight matching text; support keyboard navigation
Don't: Show suggestions without keyboard support or hide the input type

Description: Reorderable list items via drag interaction
Do: Provide keyboard alternative for reordering; show visual feedback during drag
Don't: Only support mouse drag without touch or keyboard alternatives

Description: Tool for selecting colors from a palette or entering hex values
Do: Show current color preview; include hex/rgb input fields; support keyboard navigation
Don't: Hide the selected color value or use only mouse interaction

Description: Rotating image display with navigation controls
Do: Include pause/play button; support keyboard navigation; announce slide count to screen readers
Don't: Auto-rotate without pause control or hide from screen readers

Description: Custom video playback controls overlay
Do: Include play/pause, volume, fullscreen; show captions toggle; support keyboard shortcuts
Don't: Hide controls without a way to access them or skip captions

Description: Hierarchical expandable list structure
Do: Use indentation and expand/collapse icons; support keyboard arrow navigation
Don't: Hide the hierarchy or use inconsistent indentation levels
